paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: The performance changes with respect to the depth of search. As a reference, we add the performance of ReFICR.
model_annotation: The plot titled "ReDial" illustrates the performance changes of two metrics—Recall@50 and NDCG@50—with respect to the depth of search, ranging from 1 to 5, for two methods: "Ours" and "ReFICR". The x-axis is labeled with integer values from 1 to 5, representing the search depth, and uses a linear scale with evenly spaced tick marks. The left y-axis, labeled "Recall@50", ranges from 0.30 to 0.60 with a linear scale and tick marks every 0.05. The right y-axis, labeled "NDCG@50", ranges from 0.15 to 0.22 with a linear scale and tick marks every 0.01. The green solid line with circle markers represents Recall@50 for "Ours", starting at approximately 0.35 at depth 1 and increasing steadily to about 0.49 at depth 5. The green dotted line represents Recall@50 for "ReFICR", which remains constant at approximately 0.47 across all depths. The blue solid line with square markers represents NDCG@50 for "Ours", starting at about 0.16 at depth 1 and rising to approximately 0.185 at depth 5. The blue dotted line represents NDCG@50 for "ReFICR", which remains flat at approximately 0.155 across all depths.
